platforms.name: UPL Corp (UPL Corporation Ltd, Cayman)
platforms.what: International crop protection: post-patent herbicides, fungicides, insecticides and biosolutions (NPP) sold in >140 countries; Latin America (Brazil) is the largest region

platforms.name: UPL SAS (UPL Sustainable Agri Solutions)

platforms.name: Advanta Enterprises

platforms.name: SUPERFORM Chemistries

callPoints: Seventh straight quarter of revenue and EBITDA growth; first positive Q1 PATMI in three years.
Volume −3%: Europe heatwave and sugar-beet area down ~7%; Argentina low-margin business dropped; Colombia weak. Seeds and specialty chemicals volumes strong.
UPL priced early for Middle East-driven cost inflation; competitors following; price rises 'low single to mid-single digit'.
UPL SAS 29.8% margin partly seasonal and partly price-before-cost timing; will normalise.
₹669 cr investment mainly in Sinova, a Brazilian associate (the $87 mn discussed at the CMD).
Gross debt down >$100 mn YoY to $3.0 bn; net debt in dollars flat YoY ($2.5 bn); NWC days 110 vs 86.
Mike Frank (CEO, UPL Corp) to step down; Group COO Toshan Tamhane also leaving (both effective 31-Aug-2026).

accounting.detail: Company EBITDA (₹9,588 cr FY26) excludes exchange losses on trade receivables/payables (₹316 cr) and associate/JV losses (₹194 cr); statutory/Screener EBITDA ₹9,078 cr includes them.
Non-recourse factoring ₹10,231 cr at Mar-26 ($1,079 mn) and ₹6,755 cr at Jun-26: lowers reported receivables and net debt; the cost sits in finance costs.
Impairment of financial assets ₹750 cr in FY26 (₹240 cr FY25), incl. a ₹350 cr group-level provision in Q4FY26 for the credit environment (mainly Latin America).
Profit attributable to non-controlling interests ₹298 cr (FY26); NCI equity ₹6,573 cr. Perpetual bonds were in NCI until redeemed in May-2025.
Platform P&Ls are proforma and before group eliminations; UPL SAS excludes 'Nurture'; Advanta restated for Decco.
Gross block ₹66,450 cr at Mar-26 includes ~₹23,500 cr of intangibles (Arysta brands, registrations) plus goodwill; amortisation is part of D&A.
